question: What bearer of sword, shield, bow, arrow, skull, and time-power is described?
premises: He holds sword, shield, bow, arrow, and skull.
He bears the power of time.
inference: He bears sword, shield, bow, arrow, skull and the power of time.
uncertainties: Exact arrangement of muṇḍaka in compound is uncertain.
plain_english: Bearing sword, shield, bow, arrow, and skull, he holds the power of time.
